target.statement: MSE for dynamic modeling on the Isaac3D dataset (observed time points) = 15.655e-3

compute.basis: Requires StyleGAN2 generator, GAN inversion of frames, and training a neural ODE with 5000 steps; StyleGAN2 inference and inversion are GPU-bound, and the released code likely lacks the exact Isaac3D data and pretrained models.

blockers: Pretrained StyleGAN2 models for Isaac3D and other datasets are not provided in the repository
The exact Isaac3D video sequences used for evaluation are not released
GAN inversion of frames requires a GPU and is not included in the released code
The neural ODE training uses an adaptive DOPRI5 solver which is slow on CPU
title: Modelling Latent Dynamics of StyleGAN using Neural ODEs
